scope: Controlled benchmark, not a human session. SQL resolves outgoing attacks; travel, route contention, latency, enemy navigation and player choices are not timed.
checks: Thirty class/enemy builds resolved through production SQL attack and skill functions with controlled time, real equipment stats and resource regeneration.
